LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_Summary: How the family is doing, what needs attention, what is coming up and the latest of its story.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_People: Everyone in the family: a portrait list or the family tree.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_Relationships: How one person feels about each of the people they know.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_Events: What is planned, what has just happened and the family's permanent history.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_Home: Households, beds, reserves and the family area.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TabTip_Leadership: The family's offices, ambition, alliances and institutions.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AmbitionTip: What the family is working toward. Click to open Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertsTip: Things this family may want to look at. They are listed on the Summary tab.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_OverviewTip: The full administrative view. Nothing is hidden. Choose a person to see only what they would know.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_PerspectiveTip: Only what this person knows is shown. Secret plans, undisclosed heirs and wrongs they were never told of stay hidden.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_PerspectiveShiftTip: Perspective Shift is active: the window follows the character you are playing.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Help_Summary: The Summary is built from records the mod already keeps. A concern appears only when something supports it. Click one to go to where it can be dealt with.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Alert_FoodLow: Food is below the household's target
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Alert_HousingProblem: Not everyone has a good place to sleep
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Alert_SafetyLow: The family does not feel safe
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Alert_CapabilityGap: The family is missing an important skill
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_NoHead: The house has no recognised head. Succession is in Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_NoSteward: A Steward helps the head run the house. None is named.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_FoodLow: The food the family has set aside is below what it wants to keep. See Home > Supplies.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_HousingProblem: Some members have no bed or sleep outside the family area. See Home > Households.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_SafetyLow: The family judges its home unsafe. See its ambition in Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_CapabilityGap: The family lacks someone skilled in an area it needs. See its ambition in Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_PromiseDue: Someone promised to spend time with someone and the day is near or past. See Events > Upcoming.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_OpenRift: Two people have fallen out. See their relationship.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_Grievance: A wrong between houses is unresolved. See Events > Recent.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_CeremonyPrep: An occasion needs planning. See Events > Upcoming.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_Petition: Someone asked the house for something. See Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AlertTip_Negotiation: Houses are talking about a marriage. See Leadership.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_StandingTip: How much weight the family carries in the colony (power {0}).
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NothingUpcoming: Nothing is planned, promised or expected.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RecenterTip: Zoom back to normal and centre the tree.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ShowGoneTip: Include relatives who are away or have died.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_GoneHidden: {0} relative(s) are away or have died. Show them with the button above.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ClickForDetails: Click for details. Double-click to find them in the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ViewRelationshipsTip: See how they feel about everyone they know.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NotInColony: They are not in the colony.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_TreeParentChild: A line from parents to their children. A child hangs from the point between its own two parents.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Legend_StepTip: Blue text under a name marks step-parents and step-children.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RelOwnTip: These are {0}'s own feelings. Only the person you are playing is shown.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RelFilter_EveryoneTip: Everyone they have a recorded bond with, including people outside the house.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RelNoMatch: No one matches. Try another filter or clear the search.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_BondTip_0: How emotionally attached they are. It drives wanting to spend time together and how hard a loss lands.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_BondTip_1: How much they rely on and confide in this person.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_BondTip_2: Friction between them. It drives avoidance and conflict.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_BondTip_3: How well they know each other. It helps teaching and storytelling.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Rel_LastTogether: Last time spent together on purpose: {0}
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Act_TimeTip: Have them seek this person out for a moment together.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Act_PeaceTip: Try to mend what has come between them.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Why_Overview: Choose a character first (the colony overview acts as nobody).
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Why_ActorBusy: {0} cannot act right now (not on the map, down or dead).
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Why_NotAvatar: Perspective Shift is controlling a different character.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Why_TooSoon: They tried recently. Wait a while.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Why_NotKnown: {0} does not know of this wrong.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_PlanTip: Open the plan for this occasion.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NothingOpen: No active plots, unresolved incidents or urgent promises.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NothingRecent: Nothing in this view has happened lately.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NothingChronicle: Nothing in this view has become permanent history yet.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_DefiningTip: This became part of how the family remembers itself.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Tier_Flat: It left things as they were.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Tier_Great: It was a real step closer.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_SupplyTip_Food: Days of meals the family has set aside, against how many it wants to keep.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_SupplyTip_Fuel: How long the fuel in the area's machines would last.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_SupplyTip_Medicine: Medicine the family has claimed, against what it wants to keep.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_ReservesTip: What the family holds against what it wants to keep. Drag a slider to change the target.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_PolicyEmergencyTip: When on, anyone may take food while starving and medicine for emergency treatment, even from another house's store.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_PolicyFundsTip: When on, the family may spend colony silver in barter for its own needs.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_AccessPolicy: Family and invited guests. Visitors have to knock and be let in.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_Missing_Food: No food has been set aside.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NoMap: There is no home map to draw an area on.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NameHeirTip: Only the House Head can name an heir.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RoleWhy_Head: Holds it by this house's custom: {0}.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RoleWhy_Steward: Appointed to help the head run the house.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_RoleWhy_ElectedOpen: Elected at the colony's yearly assembly.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NeedTip_Sustenance: Whether the family has food and supplies set aside.
LanguageData.WFL_FW_NeedTip_LivingSpace: Whether everyone has a place to sleep.
